title: Three-Tool Comparison Challenge
description: Give the same prompt to three different AI tools and document the differences in quality, style, and accuracy.
steps: Choose one complex, open-ended question relevant to your work
Submit the exact same prompt to ChatGPT, Claude, and one other tool
Compare outputs on: length, structure, tone, specific claims, and nuance
Identify 2-3 specific factual claims and verify them
Write a brief assessment: which tool produced the best output for THIS task, and why?
expectedOutput: A comparison report with noted strengths and weaknesses per tool for your specific use case.
bonusChallenges: Repeat with a creative task and a factual task — see if rankings change
Submit the same question a second time to the same model and note consistency
